### The Reward of Careful Walking
Author: Truth For Life (Alistair Begg)
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-aug-29-2010-11637115.html
Passage: Numbers 6:4
Points:
- The complete ban on grape products illustrates the necessity of fleeing from every appearance and degree of evil.
- Yielding even slightly to worldly habits opens a dangerous breach that can quickly lead to deeper spiritual ruin.
- Compromising behavior clouds the conscience, leaving believers divided and unsure of their moral standing.
- Choosing disciplined holiness may invite criticism, but it produces lasting spiritual safety and genuine joy.

### Bible Pathways 02/14/2003
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-02-or-14-or-2003-1184776.html
Passage: Numbers 6:2-8
Points:
- The Nazirite vow represented a voluntary, wholehearted commitment to be set apart exclusively for the Lord.
- Consecration required abstaining even from good and lawful pleasures whenever they threatened to supplant God.
- Continuing to offer sin offerings served as a reminder that human efforts alone can never achieve moral perfection.
- Believers today are called to live as holy, living sacrifices, rejecting worldly conformity to follow God's will.
